name: Kem bo sau rieng
summary: Kem bơ sầu riêng is a cold cup of fresh avocado and ripe durian. Vietnam Airlines calls it rich, gently sweet, and fragrant with durian, and prints 20,000–40,000 VND.
origin: Vung Tau. Vietnam Airlines names Nguyễn Du and Ba Cu.
taste: Vietnam Airlines pairs the richness of avocado with the smell of ripe durian, and calls the cup gently sweet.
howToEat: Eat it cold, from the cup.
